documents.title: Multi-site CT and MRI radiomics benchmark sharpens pancreatic lesion triage and reviewer challenge packs
documents.abstract_text: A multi-site CT and MRI radiomics benchmark improved lesion triage analysis while exposing wording variance and pancreatitis confounders in reviewer challenge packs. The paper argues that imaging AI work should ship with reproducible benchmarks and interpretable workflow notes.
